findings.current: I’d searched for the fastest route and ridden without stopping, day or night.
findings.defect: After abandoning his horse, Taekyung is described as riding rather than running.
findings.rationale: 달려왔으니까 describes his continuing on foot in the context of discarding the horse.
findings.replacement: I’d sought the fastest route and run without rest, day or night.
findings.source: 가장 신속한 길을 찾아 밤낮을 가리지 않고 쉼 없이 달려왔으니까.

findings.current: it seemed as if the sight of them dying horribly still hovered before my eyes.
findings.defect: The draft makes him see them dying, although his nightmare showed that they were already dead when he arrived.
findings.rationale: 죽음을 맞이한 describes people who have met their deaths; the preceding account says he found everyone dead.
findings.replacement: the sight of them, all horribly dead, still seemed to hover before my eyes.
findings.source: 처참하게 죽음을 맞이한 그들의 모습이 눈앞을 어른거리는 듯했다.

findings.current: No matter how hard I tried in each moment, the outcome didn’t change.
findings.defect: The draft turns a failure to achieve the hoped-for result into a claim that the outcome never changed.
findings.rationale: The contrast is between doing one’s best and the results, not between effort and an unchanging outcome.
findings.replacement: I gave every moment my best, but the results still fell short.
findings.source: 매 순간에 최선을 다할지라도 결과는 아니었지.

findings.current: the young Family Head of the Jin Family of Taiyuan
findings.defect: The title promotes the family’s designated junior head to its reigning Family Head.
findings.rationale: 소가주 has the packet’s established rendering “Lesser Family Head,” distinct from 가주.
findings.replacement: the Lesser Family Head of the Jin Family of Taiyuan

findings.current: And even to that deranged old man who’d wandered the world in search of the Disciple he’d left behind as his final regret and longing.
findings.defect: “He’d left behind” implies that the old man abandoned his Disciple, a relationship history the passage does not state.
findings.rationale: The Disciple remained a source of regret and attachment; the source does not say the old man left him behind.
findings.replacement: And even to that deranged old man who’d wandered the world searching for the Disciple who remained his last regret and lingering attachment.
findings.source: 생애 마지막 후회이자 미련으로 남은 제자를 찾기 위해 천하를 떠돌던 어느 정신 나간 노인에게도.

findings.current: like a grandmother gently soothing her young grandson.
findings.defect: Soothing loses the grandmother’s gentle correction of a child’s petulance.
findings.rationale: 투정을 타이르는 describes responding to and correcting the grandson’s fussing, not simply comforting him.
findings.replacement: like a grandmother gently chiding her petulant young grandson.
findings.source: 마치 어린 손자의 투정을 타이르는 할머니처럼.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it changes how Taekyung traveled, blurs the nightmare’s aftermath, and misses two relationship cues.
